turns.question: Where are streaming responses implemented, and which public API methods route into the streaming implementation?
turns.text:
I have enough to give a complete, evidence-backed answer.

## Where streaming is implemented

**Core SSE transport** — `src/core/streaming.ts`
- `export class Stream<Item> implements AsyncIterable<Item>` — the base primitive. `Stream.fromSSEResponse()` wraps a raw `Response` and parses it via `_iterSSEMessages()` / `SSEDecoder`, yielding parsed JSON events; `Stream.fromReadableStream()` handles newline-delimited JSON streams. Also exposes `.tee()` and `.toReadableStream()`.

**Wiring from request → stream** — `src/internal/parse.ts`, `defaultParseResponse()`
- Checks `props.options.stream`; if true, calls `props.options.__streamClass.fromSSEResponse(...)` (defaulting to `Stream.fromSSEResponse`). This is invoked from `src/core/api-promise.ts`'s `APIPromise` via its `parseResponse` callback, which every resource method receives implicitly through `this._client.post/get(...)`.

**Higher-level "helper" streaming wrappers** (event-emitter style, built on top of `Stream`):
- `src/lib/EventStream.ts` — `EventStream<EventTypes>`, base class providing `.on()`/`.emitted()`/abort handling for all the below.
- `src/lib/ChatCompletionStream.ts` — `ChatCompletionStream`, extends `AbstractChatCompletionRunner` (`src/lib/AbstractChatCompletionRunner.ts`), accumulates `ChatCompletionChunk`s into a snapshot. Static entry: `ChatCompletionStream.createChatCompletion()`.
- `src/lib/ChatCompletionStreamingRunner.ts` — streaming variant used for automatic tool-call loops.
- `src/lib/responses/ResponseStream.ts` — `ResponseStream`, extends `EventStream<ResponseEvents>`, static entry `ResponseStream.createResponse()`.
- `src/lib/AssistantStream.ts` — `AssistantStream`, extends `EventStream<AssistantStreamEvents>`; static entries `createThreadAssistantStream()`, `createToolAssistantStream()`, plus instance methods `_threadAssistantStream()` / `_runAssistantStream()`.
- `src/realtime/websocket.ts` (`OpenAIRealtimeWebSocket`) and `src/realtime/ws.ts` (`OpenAIRealtimeWS`) — a separate, non-SSE streaming path over raw WebSocket (`extends OpenAIRealtimeEmitter` from `src/realtime/internal-base.ts`), for the Realtime API.

## Public API methods that route into streaming

| Method | File | Mechanism |
|---|---|---|
| `client.responses.create({stream:true})` | `src/resources/responses/responses.ts` | passes `stream: body.stream ?? false` to `this._client.post`, returns `APIPromise<Stream<ResponseStreamEvent>>` |
| `client.responses.retrieve(id, {stream:true})` | same file | same pattern for polling a background response as a stream |
| `client.responses.stream(body)` | same file, line ~ `stream<Params...>` | calls `ResponseStream.createResponse()` |
| `client.chat.completions.create({stream:true})` | `src/resources/chat/completions/completions.ts` | `stream: body.stream ?? false` → `APIPromise<Stream<ChatCompletionChunk>>` |
| `client.chat.completions.stream(body)` | same file | calls `ChatCompletionStream.createChatCompletion()` |
| `client.chat.completions.runTools(body)` when `body.stream` | same file | delegates to `ChatCompletionStreamingRunner.runTools()` |
| `client.completions.create({stream:true})` (legacy Completions API) | `src/resources/completions.ts` | same `stream: body.stream ?? false` pattern → `Stream<Completion>` |
| `client.beta.threads.runs.create(threadId, {stream:true})` | `src/resources/beta/threads/runs/runs.ts` | overload returns `APIPromise<Stream<AssistantStreamEvent>>`-typed result |
| `client.beta.threads.runs.stream(threadId, body)` | same file (~line 185) | calls `AssistantStream.createToolAssistantStream()`/related |
| `client.beta.threads.runs.createAndStream(...)` | same file (~line 118) | assistant streaming helper |
| `client.beta.threads.runs.submitToolOutputsStream(...)` | same file (~line 247) | assistant streaming helper |
| `client.beta.threads.createAndRun(..., {stream:true})` / stream helper | `src/resources/beta/threads/threads.ts` | calls `AssistantStream.createThreadAssistantStream()` |
| `client.realtime` / `beta.realtime` (`OpenAIRealtimeWebSocket`, `OpenAIRealtimeWS`) | `src/realtime/websocket.ts`, `src/realtime/ws.ts` | WebSocket-based, not SSE `Stream` |

All the plain `create({stream:true})` overloads funnel through the same choke point: `this._client.post(...)` → `APIPromise` (`src/core/api-promise.ts`) → `defaultParseResponse` (`src/internal/parse.ts`) → `Stream.fromSSEResponse` (`src/core/streaming.ts`). The `.stream()`/`createAndStream()`/`runTools()` convenience methods are thin wrappers that additionally use the event-emitter subclasses (`ChatCompletionStream`, `ResponseStream`, `AssistantStream`) built on `EventStream`.

## Not verified
- I did not open `src/resources/responses/ws-base.ts` (surfaced in search, likely a WebSocket-based streaming variant for Responses) or fully read `src/lib/AbstractChatCompletionRunner.ts` internals.
- I did not confirm every audio/transcription streaming overload (`resources/audio/transcriptions.ts` shows a `class Transcriptions` in search results but I didn't inspect its `create` signature for `stream:true` support).
- I did not verify `resources/realtime/realtime.ts` (client-secrets resource) vs. the `beta/realtime` variant in detail, nor the exact WebSocket event dispatch code inside `OpenAIRealtimeEmitter`.
- I did not run/execute any code — this is static analysis of source read via `ghx`, not confirmed against actual runtime behavior.

README:
# OpenAI TypeScript and JavaScript API Library

[![NPM version](<https://img.shields.io/npm/v/openai.svg?label=npm%20(stable)>)](https://npmjs.org/package/openai) ![npm bundle size](https://img.shields.io/bundlephobia/minzip/openai) [![JSR Version](https://jsr.io/badges/@openai/openai)](https://jsr.io/@openai/openai)

This library provides convenient access to the OpenAI REST API from TypeScript or JavaScript.

It is generated from our [OpenAPI specification](https://github.com/openai/openai-openapi) with [Stainless](https://stainlessapi.com/).

To learn how to use the OpenAI API, check out our [API Reference](https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference) and [Documentation](https://platform.openai.com/docs).

## Installation

```sh
npm install openai
```

### Installation from JSR

```sh
deno add jsr:@openai/openai
npx jsr add @openai/openai
```

These commands will make the module importable from the `@openai/openai` scope. You can also [import directly from JSR](https://jsr.io/docs/using-packages#importing-with-jsr-specifiers) without an install step if you're using the Deno JavaScript runtime:

```ts
import OpenAI from 'jsr:@openai/openai';
```

## Usage

The full API of this library can be found in [api.md file](api.md) along with many [code examples](https://github.com/openai/openai-node/tree/

README:
# OpenAI TypeScript and JavaScript API Library

[![NPM version](<https://img.shields.io/npm/v/openai.svg?label=npm%20(stable)>)](https://npmjs.org/package/openai) ![npm bundle size](https://img.shields.io/bundlephobia/minzip/openai) [![JSR Version](https://jsr.io/badges/@openai/openai)](https://jsr.io/@openai/openai)

This library provides convenient access to the OpenAI REST API from TypeScript or JavaScript.

It is generated from our [OpenAPI specification](https://github.com/openai/openai-openapi) with [Stainless](https://stainlessapi.com/).

To learn how to use the OpenAI API, check out our [API Reference](https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference) and [Documentation](https://platform.openai.com/docs).

## Installation

```sh
npm install openai
```

### Installation from JSR

```sh
deno add jsr:@openai/openai
npx jsr add @openai/openai
```

These commands will make the module importable from the `@openai/openai` scope. You can also [import directly from JSR](https://jsr.io/docs/using-packages#importing-with-jsr-specifiers) without an install step if you're using the Deno JavaScript runtime:

```ts
import OpenAI from 'jsr:@openai/openai';
```

## Usage

The full API of this library can be found in [api.md file](api.md) along with many [code examples](https://github.com/openai/openai-node/tree/
